headline: On last trading day, Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty settled above 25,000; markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian stock markets NSE and BSE are closed today, Tuesday, 10 November 2026, for Diwali-Balipratipada.
No trading operations will take place across equity and derivative segments during this local holiday.
Trading on both national stock exchanges will resume on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
Global market movement showed Asian markets rallying while crude oil prices declined.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, Sensex extended gains to close above 81,000 while Nifty settled above 25,000.
Benchmark indices reached their highest closing levels in over eight months following a recent 7% rally.
India VIX surged 68% over three weeks despite the sustained upward trend in Sensex and Nifty.
Blackstone is set to become a key investor in IIFL Finance by acquiring a 15% stake.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today, November 10, for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
In the previous session, Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty settled above 25,000, reaching eight-month highs.
In stock news, Blackstone is set to acquire a 15% stake in IIFL Finance.
